lessons.title: Who is he?
lessons.en:
Kate: Look at the photo. Who is he?
Sam: He is my friend, Tom. He is a boy in Class 2.
Kate: And who is she?
Sam: She is my classmate, Lily.
Kate: Is she your teacher?
Sam: No, she isn't. Our teacher is Miss Wang.
lessons.cn:
凯特：看这张照片。他是谁？
山姆：他是我的朋友汤姆。他是二班的一个男孩。
凯特：那她是谁？
山姆：她是我的同学莉莉。
凯特：她是你的老师吗？
山姆：不，她不是。我们的老师是王老师。

lessons.title: My friends
lessons.en:
I have many friends at school.
He is Tom. He is a happy boy.
She is Lily. She is a kind girl.
Miss Wang is our teacher. We all like her.
A friend, a classmate, a teacher — they make my school day warm.
lessons.cn:
我在学校有很多朋友。
他是汤姆。他是个快乐的男孩。
她是莉莉。她是个善良的女孩。
王老师是我们的老师。我们都喜欢她。
一个朋友、一个同学、一位老师——他们让我的校园生活很温暖。
